                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">前言</h2>
<p>最近逛 Reddit 的时候，看到一个关于最被低估的 JavaScript 特性的讨论，我对此进行了总结，和大家分享一下。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">1. Set：数组去重 + 快速查找，比 filter 快 3 倍</h2>
<p>提到数组去重，很多人第一反应是 <code>filter</code> + <code>indexOf</code>，但这种写法的时间复杂度是 <code>O (n²)</code>，而 Set 天生支持 “唯一值”，查找速度是 <code>O (1)</code>，还能直接转数组。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>用户 ID 去重：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 后端返回的重复用户 ID 列表</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> duplicateIds = [<span class="hljs-number">101</span>, <span class="hljs-number">102</span>, <span class="hljs-number">102</span>, <span class="hljs-number">103</span>, <span class="hljs-number">103</span>, <span class="hljs-number">103</span>];
<span class="hljs-comment">// 1 行去重</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> uniqueIds = [...<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Set</span>(duplicateIds)];
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(uniqueIds); <span class="hljs-comment">// [101,102,103]</span>
</code></pre>
<p>避免重复绑定事件：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> listenedEvents = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Set</span>();
<span class="hljs-comment">// 封装事件绑定函数，防止同一事件重复绑定</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">safeAddEvent</span>(<span class="hljs-params">eventName, handler</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!listenedEvents.<span class="hljs-title function_">has</span>(eventName)) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(eventName, handler);
    listenedEvents.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(eventName); <span class="hljs-comment">// 标记已绑定</span>
  }
}
<span class="hljs-comment">// 调用 2 次也只会绑定 1 次 scroll 事件</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">safeAddEvent</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"scroll"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"滚动了"</span>));
<span class="hljs-title function_">safeAddEvent</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"scroll"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"滚动了"</span>));
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">2. Object.entries () + Object.fromEntries ()：对象数组互转神器</h2>
<p>以前想遍历对象，要用 <code>for...in</code> 循环，外加判断 <code>hasOwnProperty</code>；如果想把数组转成对象，只能手动写循环。这对组合直接一键搞定。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>筛选对象属性，过滤掉空值：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 后端返回的用户信息，包含空值字段</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> userInfo = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">age</span>: <span class="hljs-number">28</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">avatar</span>: <span class="hljs-string">""</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 空值，需要过滤</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">phone</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"13800138000"</span>,
};
<span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 转成[key,value]数组，过滤空值；2. 转回对象</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> filteredUser = <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromEntries</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">entries</span>(userInfo).<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">[key, value]</span>) =&gt;</span> value !== <span class="hljs-string">""</span>));
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(filteredUser);
<span class="hljs-comment">// {name: "张三", age:28, phone: "13800138000"}</span>
</code></pre>
<p>URL 参数转对象（不用再写正则了）</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 地址栏的参数：?name=张三&amp;age=28&amp;gender=男</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> searchStr = <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">location</span>.<span class="hljs-property">search</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 直接转成对象，支持中文和特殊字符</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> paramObj = <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromEntries</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">URLSearchParams</span>(searchStr));

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(paramObj); <span class="hljs-comment">// {name: "张三", age: "28", gender: "男"}</span>
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">3. ?? 与 ??=：比 || 靠谱</h2>
<p>用 <code>||</code> 设置默认值时，会把 <code>0</code>、<code>""</code>、<code>false</code>这些 “有效假值” 当成空值。比如用户输入 <code>0</code>（表示数量），<code>count || 10</code>会返回 <code>10</code>，但这里其实应该返回 <code>0</code>。而<code>??</code>只判断 <code>null/undefined</code>。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>处理用户输入的 “有效假值”：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 用户输入的数量（ 0 是有效数值，不能替换）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> userInputCount = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 错误写法：会把 0 当成空值，返回 10</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> wrongCount = userInputCount || <span class="hljs-number">10</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 正确写法：只判断 null/undefined，返回 0</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> correctCount = userInputCount ?? <span class="hljs-number">10</span>;

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(wrongCount, correctCount); <span class="hljs-comment">// 10, 0</span>
</code></pre>
<p>给对象补默认值（不会覆盖已有值）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 前端传入的配置，可能缺少 retries 字段</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> requestConfig = { <span class="hljs-attr">timeout</span>: <span class="hljs-number">5000</span> };

<span class="hljs-comment">// 只有当 retries 为 null/undefined 时，才赋值 3（不覆盖已有值）</span>
requestConfig.<span class="hljs-property">retries</span> ??= <span class="hljs-number">3</span>;
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(requestConfig); <span class="hljs-comment">// {timeout:5000, retries:3}</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 如果已有值，不会被覆盖</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> oldConfig = { <span class="hljs-attr">timeout</span>: <span class="hljs-number">3000</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">retries</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2</span> };
oldConfig.<span class="hljs-property">retries</span> ??= <span class="hljs-number">3</span>;
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(oldConfig); <span class="hljs-comment">// {timeout:3000, retries:2}</span>
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">4. Intl API：原生国际化 API</h2>
<p>很多人会用 moment.js 处理日期、货币格式化，但这个库体积特别大（压缩后也有几十 KB）；而 <code>Intl</code> 是浏览器原生 API，支持货币、日期、数字的本地化，体积为 0，还能自动适配地区。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>多语言货币格式化（适配中英文）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> price = <span class="hljs-number">1234.56</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 人民币格式（自动加 ¥ 和千分位）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cnyPrice = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Intl</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">NumberFormat</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"zh-CN"</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">style</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"currency"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">currency</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"CNY"</span>,
}).<span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(price);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 美元格式（自动加 $ 和千分位）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> usdPrice = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Intl</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">NumberFormat</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"en-US"</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">style</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"currency"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">currency</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"USD"</span>,
}).<span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(price);

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(cnyPrice, usdPrice); <span class="hljs-comment">// ¥1,234.56 $1,234.56</span>
</code></pre>
<p>日期本地化（不用手动拼接年月日）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> now = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>();

<span class="hljs-comment">// 中文日期：2025年11月3日 15:40:22</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cnDate = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Intl</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">DateTimeFormat</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"zh-CN"</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">year</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"numeric"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">month</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"long"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">day</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"numeric"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">hour</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"2-digit"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">minute</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"2-digit"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">second</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"2-digit"</span>,
}).<span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(now);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 英文日期：November 3, 2025, 03:40:22 PM</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> enDate = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Intl</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">DateTimeFormat</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"en-US"</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">year</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"numeric"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">month</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"long"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">day</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"numeric"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">hour</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"2-digit"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">minute</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"2-digit"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">second</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"2-digit"</span>,
}).<span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(now);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(cnDate, enDate);
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-5">5. Intersection Observer：图片懒加载 + 滚动加载，不卡主线程</h2>
<p>传统我们用 <code>scroll</code>事件 + <code>getBoundingClientRect()</code>判断元素是否在视口，会频繁触发重排，导致页面卡顿；<code>Intersection Observer</code>API 是异步监听，不阻塞主线程，性能直接提升一大截。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>图片懒加载（可用于优化首屏加载速度）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 用data-src存真实图片地址，src放占位图 --&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span> <span class="hljs-attr">data-src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"https://xxx.com/real-img.jpg"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"placeholder.jpg"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy-img"</span> /&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化观察者</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> lazyObserver = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">IntersectionObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entries</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  entries.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entry</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 当图片进入视口</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (entry.<span class="hljs-property">isIntersecting</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> img = entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>;
      img.<span class="hljs-property">src</span> = img.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">src</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 加载真实图片</span>
      lazyObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">unobserve</span>(img); <span class="hljs-comment">// 加载后停止监听</span>
    }
  });
});
<span class="hljs-comment">// 给所有懒加载图片添加监听</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">".lazy-img"</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">img</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  lazyObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(img);
});
</code></pre>
<p>列表滚动加载更多（避免一次性加载过多数据）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">ul</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"news-list"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">ul</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 加载提示，放在列表底部 --&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"load-more"</span>&gt;</span>加载中...<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> loadObserver = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">IntersectionObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entries</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (entries[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>].<span class="hljs-property">isIntersecting</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 当加载提示进入视口，请求下一页数据</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchNextPageData</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">data</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">renderNews</span>(data); <span class="hljs-comment">// 渲染新列表项</span>
    });
  }
});
<span class="hljs-comment">// 监听加载提示元素</span>
loadObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"load-more"</span>));
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-6">6. Promise.allSettled ()：批量请求不 “挂掉”，比 Promise.all 更实用</h2>
<p>如果使用 Promise.all，当批量请求时，只要有一个请求失败，Promise.all 就会直接 reject，其他成功的请求结果就拿不到了；而 allSettled 会等待所有请求完成，不管成功失败，还能分别处理结果。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>批量获取用户信息 + 订单 + 消息（部分接口失败不影响整体）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 3个并行请求，可能有失败的</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> requestList = [
  <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"/api/user/101"</span>), <span class="hljs-comment">// 成功</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"/api/orders/101"</span>), <span class="hljs-comment">// 失败（比如订单不存在）</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"/api/messages/101"</span>), <span class="hljs-comment">// 成功</span>
];

<span class="hljs-comment">// 等待所有请求完成，处理成功和失败的结果</span>
<span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">allSettled</span>(requestList).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">results</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理成功的请求</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> successData = results.<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">res</span>) =&gt;</span> res.<span class="hljs-property">status</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"fulfilled"</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">res</span>) =&gt;</span> res.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>());
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 记录失败的请求（方便排查问题）</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> failedRequests = results.<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">res</span>) =&gt;</span> res.<span class="hljs-property">status</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"rejected"</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">res</span>) =&gt;</span> res.<span class="hljs-property">reason</span>.<span class="hljs-property">url</span>);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"成功数据："</span>, successData);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"失败接口："</span>, failedRequests); <span class="hljs-comment">// ["/api/orders/101"]</span>
});
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">7. element.closest ()：向上找父元素最安全的方式</h2>
<p>传统如果想找某个元素的父元素，比如点击列表项找列表，需要使用 <code>element.parentNode.parentNode</code>，但一旦 DOM 结构变了，代码就崩了；<code>closest()</code> 回直接根据 CSS 选择器找最近的祖先元素，不管嵌套多少层。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>点击列表项，给列表容器加高亮：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">ul</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"user-list"</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">li</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"user-item"</span>&gt;</span>张三<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">li</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">li</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"user-item"</span>&gt;</span>李四<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">li</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">ul</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">".user-item"</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">item</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  item.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"click"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 找到最近的.user-list（不管中间嵌套多少层）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> list = e.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">closest</span>(<span class="hljs-string">".user-list"</span>);
    list.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toggle</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"active"</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 切换高亮</span>
  });
});
</code></pre>
<p>输入框聚焦，给表单组加样式：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"form-group"</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">label</span>&gt;</span>用户名<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">label</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">input</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"text"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"username"</span> /&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> usernameInput = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"username"</span>);
usernameInput.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"focus"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 找到最近的.form-group，加focused样式</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> formGroup = e.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">closest</span>(<span class="hljs-string">".form-group"</span>);
  formGroup.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"focused"</span>);
});
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-8">8. URL + URLSearchParams：处理 URL 方便多了</h2>
<p>传统解析 URL 参数、修改参数，还要写复杂的正则表达式，有时还得处理中文编码问题；当然我们会直接引入三方库来处理，但毕竟还要引入多余的苦，其实 URL API 可以直接解析 URL 结构，URLSearchParams 可用于处理参数，支持增删改查，自动编码，方便多了。</p>
<p>解析 URL 参数（支持中文和特殊字符）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 当前页面URL：https://xxx.com/user?name=张三&amp;age=28&amp;gender=男</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> currentUrl = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">URL</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">location</span>.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 获取参数</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(currentUrl.<span class="hljs-property">searchParams</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"name"</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 张三</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(currentUrl.<span class="hljs-property">hostname</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// xxx.com（域名）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(currentUrl.<span class="hljs-property">pathname</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// /user（路径）</span>
</code></pre>
<p>修改 URL 参数，跳转新页面：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> url = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">URL</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"https://xxx.com/list"</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 添加参数</span>
url.<span class="hljs-property">searchParams</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">append</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"page"</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>);
url.<span class="hljs-property">searchParams</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">append</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"size"</span>, <span class="hljs-number">10</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 修改参数</span>
url.<span class="hljs-property">searchParams</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"page"</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 删除参数</span>
url.<span class="hljs-property">searchParams</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">delete</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"size"</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(url.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// https://xxx.com/list?page=3</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">location</span>.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> = url.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 跳转到第3页</span>
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-9">9. for...of 循环：比 forEach 灵活，还支持 break 和 continue</h2>
<p>我们都知道，<code>forEach</code> 不能用 <code>break</code>中断循环，也不能用 <code>continue</code>跳过当前项。而<code>for...of</code>不仅支持中断，还能遍历数组、Set、Map、字符串，甚至获取索引。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>遍历数组，找到目标值后中断：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> productList = [
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"手机"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">price</span>: <span class="hljs-number">5999</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"电脑"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">price</span>: <span class="hljs-number">9999</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"平板"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">price</span>: <span class="hljs-number">3999</span> },
];

<span class="hljs-comment">// 找价格大于8000的产品，找到后中断</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> product <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> productList) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (product.<span class="hljs-property">price</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">8000</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"找到高价产品："</span>, product); <span class="hljs-comment">// {id:2, name:"电脑", ...}</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 中断循环，不用遍历剩下的</span>
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>遍历 Set，获取索引：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> uniqueTags = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Set</span>([<span class="hljs-string">"前端"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"JS"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"CSS"</span>]);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 用 entries() 获取索引和值</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [index, tag] <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> [...uniqueTags].<span class="hljs-title function_">entries</span>()) {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`索引<span class="hljs-subst">${index}</span>：<span class="hljs-subst">${tag}</span>`</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 索引 0：前端，索引 1：JS...</span>
}
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-10">10. 顶层 await：模块异步初始化</h2>
<p>以前在 ES 模块里想异步加载配置，必须写个 async 函数再调用；现在 top-level await 允许你在模块顶层直接用 await，其他模块导入时会自动等待，不用再手动处理异步。</p>
<p>举个例子：</p>
<p>模块初始化时加载配置：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// config.js</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 顶层直接 await，加载后端配置</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> response = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"/api/config"</span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> appConfig = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> response.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// {baseUrl: "https://xxx.com", timeout: 5000}</span>
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// api.js（导入 config.js，自动等待配置加载完成）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { appConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./config.js"</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 直接用配置，不用关心异步</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> apiClient = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">baseUrl</span>: appConfig.<span class="hljs-property">baseUrl</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.baseUrl}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${url}</span>`</span>, { <span class="hljs-attr">timeout</span>: appConfig.<span class="hljs-property">timeout</span> });
  },
};
</code></pre>
<p>点击按钮动态加载组件（按需加载，减少首屏体积）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 点击“图表”按钮，才加载图表组件</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"show-chart-btn"</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"click"</span>, <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 动态导入图表模块，await 等待加载完成</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { renderChart } = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"./chart-module.js"</span>);
  <span class="hljs-title function_">renderChart</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"#chart-container"</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 渲染图表</span>
});
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-11">结语</h2>
<p>可以看到，以前我们依赖的第三方库，其实原生 API 早就能解决，比如用 Intl 替代 moment.js，用 Set 替代 lodash 的 uniq，用 Intersection Observer 替代懒加载，随着老旧的浏览器被讨论，兼容性越来越好，这些 API 以后会成为基操。</p></div></div>
